interpretation: Exploratory follow-up motivated by zero three-assay matches in all real-data application arms; does not replace primary outcomes.
parent_arms: All six real original/control representation/seed arms from application_v1
operation: Reuse each frozen per-assay ICA mixing, mean and training source encoding; run native matching/joint-mixing/graph stages on each pair. No ICA refits, feature changes or new datasets.
multiplicity_note: Native two-domain matching recomputes adjusted KS alpha for that pair. A separate count under the original three-domain adjusted alpha distinguishes this change from the consistency requirement.
readouts: All pairwise matched-source counts and native anonymous coefficient matrices, including failures
Heldout paired feature-correlation RMSE versus zero baseline
Matched-source count with original global adjusted KS alpha; descriptive only
scope: Matching nonrejection is not calibrated false-sharing control. Agreement with a paired observational moment is not causal-edge validation. No causal graph threshold or model selection is added.
